svg.title: TIG Rotator — wiring diagram, revision 2.7
svg.desc: Original project wiring layout in the V5 graphite and orange design. Firmware input requirements are explicit; interface blocks are functional requirements, not verified installed hardware.

g.text: 36 V optimal / 24 V works / min 5 A
3.3 V output: HIGH OK / LOW fault
1. Shown: common-cathode / plus inputs to signals.
Check your driver manual for input voltage/current.
Use a 3.3 V-compatible adapter when required.
Never apply 5 V or motor supply to ESP32 GPIO.
2. Firmware: ENA HIGH = inhibit; verify at the driver.
UI microstep must match the physical DIP setting.
4. NC E-STOP needs HIGH healthy / LOW fault output.
Test pressed, released and broken cable states.
ISR sets ENA HIGH. Physical stop time unmeasured.
5. ALM: verify driver output and 3.3 V conditioning.
6. ADS: VDD = 3.3 V, SDA = GPIO7, SCL = GPIO8, pot = A0.
ADDR -> GND = 0x48. REQUIRED: ADDR is not pre-wired
on 10-pin modules. JP1: SDA 23 / SCL 25. Not 24/26.
7. Motor colors are examples. Identify coil pairs.
8. TIG HF: screen + driver + PSU in grounded metal.
Keep logic wires away from welding/power cables.
Dots = connected. Crossings without dots = separate.
Use Setup Wizard to match microstep and direction.
Check physical E-STOP and driver inhibit before use.
Dashed boxes = required / optional interface functions.
